text:
ali_cust: Hey team — customer hitting 413 from /v1/rerank. Message is just 'Payload too large'. They sent ~40 docs with long passages. They expect either a clearer error or guidance.
sam_support: Thanks @ali_cust. Do we have a repro curl and approximate sizes? Also: is this on hosted or dedicated?
ali_cust: hosted. curl attached (redacted token):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $$$' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"'""long product description..."'","documents":[{"id":"doc1","text":"<~12k chars>"}, {"id":"doc2","text":"<~9k chars>"}, ...]}'
```
They said payload size ~450KB and they see 413. They were surprised — they thought rerank accepts large doc lists.
maria_engineering: Quick note: current limiter is character-based at the edge (lib parses bytes) and caps at ~400KB per request for rerank. That yields confusing UX because users think in tokens or doc counts.
sam_support: So error message currently returned by the gateway is generic. Customer asked whether it's token budget/billing — they were worried about being charged for partial processing.
nina_product: We should avoid noisy billing alarms. UX idea: change 413 body to include: allowed_bytes, provided_bytes, and per-doc approximate token estimates. Also provide suggested remediation steps (snip docs, send passages, or set max_docs).
ali_cust: Would be huge if the error could say which doc pushed them over (e.g. doc id and bytes). Right now they can't triage without pulling traces.
maria_engineering: Agree. Short-term fix: in support reply recommend simple chunking: take each doc.text and run a cheap char-len filter, drop passages >2k chars or replace with snippet field. Example snippet in JS: 
```
const chunks = doc.text.match(/.{1,2000}/gs).slice(0,3) // keep first 3 chunks
```
That will reduce payload and still keep context for rerank.
sam_support: Can we provide a reproducible curl example to the customer that demonstrates chunking? If so, include before/after sizes so they see the difference.
ali_cust: I'll send a before/after. Also customer reported that when they truncated docs client-side they got much different ranking (unexpected scores) — they think we're re-ranking on truncated content incorrectly.
maria_engineering: That can happen: reranker is sensitive to query-document overlap; removing passages can flip scores. We should warn in KB: "snippeting may change results — prefer passage-level ranking followed by assembly". Also add a guidance snippet for "run a quick embed check".
devops_bot: incident-note: reproduce ticket created #INC-2091, logs captured (edge-gateway 10:03 UTC), sample payload stored in s3://triage/1771234000.json
nina_product: Action items: (1) support reply with recommended chunking + curl example + note about score drift, (2) engineering to add expanded 413 payload with bytes and doc-id hint, (3) docs to add KB page about chunking vs passage ranking.
maria_engineering: For the engineering task: I'll open PR to change error body to: { "error": "payload_too_large", "allowed_bytes":"400000", "provided_bytes":"<n>", "top_offender":"doc12","suggested_action":"snippet_docs|split_requests" }. Will also add an opt-in header X-Redwood-Input-Size for debug. ETA EOD.
sam_support: Perfect. I'll draft the support message now and include a minimal chunking curl example + guidance about score drift. Will mark customer as P2 until engineering PR lands.
ali_cust: Thanks — customer is fine with workaround. Sending before/after now. :thumbsup:
